more.question: N5
more.good_when: A maintainer finds a test named for each end of each range that a row accepts, on the negative side as well as the positive: a credit line whose quantity or whose amount reaches -1000000000 is refused, and one just inside it is read. They also find a test named for each choice the package offers its callers, such as an invoice printed in a currency other than EUR, and a Line built without a quantity counting as one. When any of these breaks, the failing test's name says which case it was.

more.question: N7
more.good_when: Breaking any behavior makes a test fail. Today none fails when a row whose quantity cell is left empty stops being refused and the command ends in a traceback; when a credit line whose amount is -1000000000 or below gets printed instead of refused; when render prints EUR whatever currency its caller asks for; when a Line built without a quantity counts as 0 instead of 1; or when a Line no longer shows its description, price and quantity.
